text:
deploy-bot: starting CONFIG-ONLY rollout cfg-2026-03-18-1719805555 -> changing routing/timeouts/batching. rolling canary at 1% now. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. diff summary below. docs: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-rollouts

```
routing.max_concurrency: 200 -> 150
router.fallback_weight: 0.05 -> 0.08
batcher.min_tokens: 8 -> 6
timeout.per_token_ms: 40 -> 50
rate_limit_per_tenant: 100rps -> 80rps
model_pin: none -> inference-v2.1
```

Maria: can we pin model for canary to avoid model-side variance? will do a separate model change later.
Kevin: yes pin to inference-v2.1 in the canary config. added note in the manifest.
Jess: adding a soft flood-gate on tenant rate limits as well. will set burst window low for first 30m.
Charlie: observability links — p95 latency dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/latency/p95?orgId=1 and kv-evictions panel: https://grafana.internal/d/kvcache/evictions

sre-bot: deploy-bot reported canary 1% started at 1719805555.

Kevin: monitoring plan: watch p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv cache evictions, and qps per backend. if p95 > +20% or 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m -> rollback. also abort if kvcache evictions climb > 300/s for 3m.
Maria: agreed. adding a temporary circuit-breaker: "cascade_throttle=true" for canary to limit blast radius.
Jess: internal release note written: "config-only: throttle down routes, increased per-token timeout to handle tail latency, lowered batch min tokens to reduce latency for small inputs. pinned model v2.1 for canary."
Charlie: will watch traces for any tokenization regressions. will post quick snapshots at 5/10/20 min.

deploy-bot: canary promoted to 10% at 1719806260.
Kevin: can everyone confirm they see no spike at 10%?
Charlie: p95 looks +3% at 10% so far, 5xx steady at 0.04%. kv evict stable.
Maria: no error budget burn. +1 to proceed to 30% after 12m.
Jess: bumping tenant rate cap remains in effect.

sre-bot: automated canary checks passed at 10% (latency/5xx/kvcache).

Kevin: plan to move to 30% now, then 60% -> 100% if stable. criteria same as above. any objections?
Maria: fine, proceed. I'll keep an eye on model-serving traces.
Jess: I'll keep release note updated and flag in the console changelog.

deploy-bot: promoted to 30% at 1719806520.
Charlie: quick note — small uptick in p99 for long sequences, not in p95. seems within expected tradeoff for timeout change.
Kevin: acceptable. continue.

deploy-bot: promoting to 60% at 1719806700.
Maria: watching. if p95 crosses +12% at 60% we'll pause and consider throttling adjustments.

sre-bot: alert rule: if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m, ops channel will auto-ping @oncall.

Jess: final checklist before 100% — ensure config is saved in release notes and a follow-up ticket to revert model_pin after 1 day if no regressions.
Kevin: rollback command (if needed): `deploy rollback-config cfg-2026-03-18-1719805555` or run `deploy rollback 1719805555` from ops shell.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 1719806840. all automated checks green.
Maria: thanks team. created follow-up ticket RW-8943 to validate downstream evals and to remove model_pin in 24h if stable.
Charlie: will do a final pass on traces in 1h and post summary.
Jess: publishing internal release note now and tagging support. :tada:
Kevin: closing out. if any late regressions, follow rollback command above.

sre-bot: summary: config-only deploy completed (cfg-2026-03-18-1719805555) canary progression 1%->10%->30%->60%->100%. no automatic rollback triggered."
